nodes.text: 網戀騙局偷心又偷金，您會中招嗎？
nodes.text_en: How to protect your heart (and bank account) from romance scams
nodes.text_sc: 网恋骗局偷心又偷金，您会上当吗？

nodes.text: 我同您一樣都受過情傷，遇上您實在太幸運！
nodes.text_en: You and I are one and the same: we both know what a broken heart feels like. I'm so lucky to have found you.
nodes.text_sc: 我和您一样，都受过情伤，遇上您真的太幸运了！

nodes.text: 我好掛住您，您呢幾日做咗啲乜？
nodes.text_en: I really miss you. What have you been up to this past week?
nodes.text_sc: 我好想您，您这几天做了些什么？

nodes.text: 這些可能是一般的甜言蜜語，但也可能是網戀騙子假扮理想伴侶、打探個人背景的對白。
nodes.text_en: While these sweet words may sound like music to anyone's ears, they could also be a ploy used by scammers to catfish you and try to prompt you to reveal more about your personal life.
nodes.text_sc: 这些可能是一般的甜言蜜语，但也可能是网恋骗子假扮理想伴侣、打探个人背景的对白。

nodes.text: 如果對方是素未謀面的網友，那您就要加倍小心。在他們「放長線」與您建立信任，並成為您生活中的一部分後，對白就可能由普通的噓寒問暖，變成：
nodes.text_en: If you've never met this person in real life, you should be extra careful. Scammers may invest time in building up a certain level of trust with you to become a regular fixture in your life. Once that happens, things could quickly start to go wrong:
nodes.text_sc: 如果对方是素未谋面的网友，那您就要加倍小心。在他们“放长线”与您建立信任，并成为您生活中的一部分后，对白就可能由普通的嘘寒问暖，变成：

nodes.text: 我唔喺香港，唔可以同您見面，咁啱個cam又壞咗，真黑仔！
nodes.text_en: I've been travelling and I'm out of town right now, so I can't meet up with you. Also, can you believe my bad luck? My webcam has just stopped working!
nodes.text_sc: 我现在人在海外，不能和您见面，刚好摄像头又坏了，运气真差！

nodes.text: 我呢排周轉困難，您可唔可以匯款俾我？幾千蚊都得。
nodes.text_en: I'm a little short on cash right now. Could you help me out by wiring some money to tide me over? Even a few thousand dollars would help.
nodes.text_sc: 我这阵子周转困难，您可以汇款给我吗？几千元也行。

nodes.text: 當您的「網上伴侶」不停推託和您見面，一次又一次地向您索取金錢，您還會相信對方嗎？
nodes.text_en: When someone you consider your 'online soulmate' is constantly making excuses not to meet up and is always asking you for money, would you still believe you've found 'the one'?
nodes.text_sc: 当您的“网上伴侣”不停推托和您见面，一次又一次地向您索取金钱，您还会相信对方吗？

nodes.text: 防範網戀騙局貼士
nodes.text_en: Tips to protect your heart and your pocket from online love scams
nodes.text_sc: 防范网恋骗局建议

nodes.text: 不想當局者迷，人財兩失，就要時常保持警惕，不要輕易向認識不深的人匯款。當您為網上「真愛」情迷意亂的時候，先停一停，回想您倆相處時有沒有甚麼警號，再做好以下措施，不要將錢包雙手奉上。
nodes.text_en: Always stay alert. Never send money to people you don't know much about. Don't give in to the initial rush of emotions you may feel after finding a connection with someone online. Take a pause, look out for red flags and take these steps before shelling out.
nodes.text_sc: 不想当局者迷，人财两失，就要时常保持警惕，不要轻易向认识不深的人汇款。当您为网上“真爱”情迷意乱的时候，先停下来，回想您俩相处时有没有什么警号，再做好以下措施，不要将钱包双手奉上。

nodes.text: 保護個人資料
nodes.text_en: Protect your personal information
nodes.text_sc: 保护个人信息

nodes.text: 千萬不要向素未謀面的人提供銀行戶口及密碼等敏感資料。
nodes.text_en: Don't give sensitive information to people you've never met, including your bank account details and passwords.
nodes.text_sc: 千万不要向素未谋面的人提供银行账户及密码等敏感信息。

nodes.text: 避免在社交媒體分享太多個人資料
nodes.text_en: Don't overshare your personal information on social media
nodes.text_sc: 避免在社交媒体分享太多个人信息

nodes.text: 以免騙徒用「社交工程」技倆哄您上當。
nodes.text_en: Scammers can easily piece together a story from the information you share on your social media accounts and target you with social engineering attacks.
nodes.text_sc: 以免骗徒用“社交工程”技俩哄您上当。

nodes.text: 諸多推搪要小心
nodes.text_en: Keep your guard up if the excuses start pouring in
nodes.text_sc: 诸多推搪要小心

nodes.text: 如果「網上伴侶」總是不和您見面，必須警覺。
nodes.text_en: Are you starting to receive lots of excuses from your online lover about why they can't turn on their webcam or meet you in person? That's a huge red flag. Stay alert.
nodes.text_sc: 如果“网上伴侣”总是不和您见面，必须警觉。

nodes.text: 不要告訴別人您的財務狀况
nodes.text_en: Don't reveal anything about your finances
nodes.text_sc: 不要告诉别人您的财务状况

nodes.text: 當對方詢問您的財務狀况，甚至要求您匯錢時，就要特別小心。
nodes.text_en: If they start asking about your finances or asking for money, you should be cautious.
nodes.text_sc: 当对方询问您的财务状况，甚至要求您汇钱时，就要特别小心。

nodes.text: 不要輕易相信他們提供的資料
nodes.text_en: Don't blindly trust information they provide
nodes.text_sc: 不要轻易相信他们提供的资料

nodes.text: 有圖未必有真相，您可以在網上以圖搜圖，確認照片真假。您也可以試探對方，查證對方的背景資料是否屬實。
nodes.text_en: The photos or selfies they've sent you might be fake, so it's best to do your own verification. Use an app or go online to reverse image search what they sent you. The back story of their lives could also be made up. Ask questions and do your own research to check the details.
nodes.text_sc: 有图未必有真相，您可以在网上以图搜图，确认照片真假。您也可以试探对方，查证对方的背景资料是否属实。

nodes.text: 網上情緣騙徒善於牽動您的情緒，令您不能自拔，花言巧語千萬不要信以為真。
nodes.text_en: Love scammers are well-versed at their art of deception and know exactly how to tug at your heartstrings. Don't let their sweet talk lure you into handing over your money, bank details or other personal data.
nodes.text_sc: 网上情缘骗徒善于牵动您的情绪，令您不能自拔，花言巧语千万不要信以为真。

nodes.text: 如果懷疑已經遇上詐騙，請即時向我們舉報。
nodes.text_en: If you think you've already experienced a scam, don't wait any longer and report it to us immediately.
nodes.text_sc: 如果怀疑已经遇上诈骗，请即时向我们举报。
